message: Hi Sibling, I've been really worried about Michael lately. He's been so distant at home. Have you noticed anything at school that might be causing this?

I really appreciated our chat today; it lifted some of the weight off my shoulders. Opening up about the bullying from Jason and his friends in the hallway has been tough, and the looming finals in Math and Science aren't helping my stress levels. Talking it through has given me a bit of peace, though. Thanks for being there to listen and for the strategies on dealing with bullies and exam preparation tips. Also, thanks for agreeing to keep the secret for me.
Congratulations Michael on winning your first chess match with the society! We're proud to have you. Remember, this is a safe space away from the stress of school and exams.
